en.gameDesc: Reconstruct mathematical proofs step by step. Steps are shuffled — drag or select them in the correct order to rebuild the proof.

af.gameDesc: Herkonstrueer wiskundige bewyse stap vir stap. Stappe is geskud — sleep of kies hulle in die korrekte volgorde om die bewys te herbou.

zu.gameDesc: Phinda wakhe ubufakazi bezibalo isinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Izinyathelo zixutshiwe — hudula noma ukhethe ngokulandelana okuyikho ukuze uphinde wakhe ubufakazi.
